title: Steadier Figma tests and summaries
summary: Figma prototype tests are more reliable for testers, and each session is summarised once, with a backup if the first try fails.
label: Test

title: Change or remove your custom domain yourself
summary: You can now switch a site to a different custom domain, or remove it, without contacting support.
label: Publish

title: Custom domains for Figma sites
summary: Sites made from a Figma prototype now get the same settings as HTML sites, including your own domain.
label: Publish

title: Sign in with Google
summary: You can sign in to Aero with your Google account, and link it to an existing email and password.
label: Plans and account

title: Set up a test from the same prompt
summary: The prompt that publishes your site can now set up a test on it too.
label: Test

title: Tasks are optional
summary: A test no longer needs tasks. Leave them out and testers explore freely.
label: Test

title: Publish from Claude or ChatGPT with one prompt
summary: Built something in Claude or ChatGPT? Aero now gives you one prompt to publish it from the same chat.
label: Publish

title: Passwords, favicons and visits for your sites
summary: Every site now has a settings page: its name, password protection, favicon and visits.
label: Publish

title: Test an HTML site, with tasks
summary: You can now run a test on any HTML site you’ve published, not only on Figma prototypes.
label: Test

title: Drop an HTML folder and it’s live
summary: Aero now hosts HTML sites: a single file, a folder or a zip, live at its own aeroapp.ai address.
label: Publish
